app.notes: BetterBahn is a Next.js 16 app (tRPC API routes plus React UI) with no database or accounts. It takes a bahn.de share link, looks the journey up, then streams a split-ticket analysis by querying every intermediate stop. Setup: mise.toml pins node 26.13.1 and pnpm 11.1.1 (aqua attestation checks are turned off because sigstore is unreachable here). .ui-capture/build.sh runs pnpm install, pnpm build and assembles the standalone server the way the Dockerfile does. .ui-capture/start.sh unsets proxy variables, starts the DB stub on :4455 and runs .next/standalone/server.js on $PORT (4454) with TZ=Europe/Berlin. Data: 30 saved trips covering realistic German routes, travel dates from 2026-11-18 to 2027-01-30, and a mix of direct ICE/IC trips, trips with one change (e.g. Hamburg→Fulda→Frankfurt, Berlin→Hannover→Oldenburg, Dortmund→Mannheim→Freiburg) and regional-only trips (Hamburg→Kiel RE7, Hamburg→Uelzen→Hannover). Some trips have large savings, some small, and regional ones have none ('keine günstigeren Split-Ticket Optionen'). Main areas: (1) '/' is the home page with the hero and the search form, where you paste the DB 'Teilen' text (e.g. 'Verbindung ansehen: https://www.bahn.de/buchung/start?vbid=7847e36d-f342-4f21-9ed3-6b41f0a5d0df') and choose BahnCard, age, Deutschland-Ticket and class, all saved in localStorage. (2) '/discount?vbid=…' shows the 'Wähle deine Verbindung' journey card with legs, platforms and price, a live progress box while stations are checked, then the original journey next to the best split-ticket option, with expandable segments. The entry URL is Hamburg Hbf→München Hbf, ICE, 28.11.2026 08:01, BahnCard 25, 2nd class (€74.99 through, best split via Kassel-Wilhelmshöhe). Other ready-made vbids: 7847e36d-f342-4f21-9ed3-6b41f0a5d0df (Magdeburg→Oldenburg IC 2036, the repo's sample), 0d9e2b71-4c6a-4f3e-8b55-2e7c9a1d3f60 (Berlin→München), 4a1d7e3b-8f2c-4e96-a5b1-c3e8d0f6a279 (Hamburg→Frankfurt with a change in Fulda), 0e9a3d7c-5f1b-4c84-a2e6-b8d4f0c3a951 (Hamburg→Kiel regional). The full list is TRIPS in .ui-capture/stub/network.mjs. Unknown vbids return a DB-style 404, which the app shows as its error box.
